title: Wolf Emerging from Abyss
description: A vibrant green and blue wolf with glowing white eyes emerges from the cracked edge of a circular cosmic pool, looking upward with mouth open. The pool contains swirling brown liquid, green lily pads, red flowers, and puzzle pieces floating around a dark central vortex with a bright white light at its core.
prompt: A surreal scene featuring a vibrant green and blue wolf with glowing white eyes and red markings emerging from the cracked rim of a large circular pool, looking upward with open mouth. The pool has swirling brown liquid, green lily pads, red flowers, and scattered red and blue puzzle pieces floating on the surface. At the center is a dark vortex with a radiant white light and radiating grid lines, set against a dark background.
